name: regression-v1
about: The CI regression gate's suite (task 6.2). A fixture assistant with a small knowledge base, a SQLite shop database, the calculator and no web search. Each case carries a play: what the canned model does for that question. Everything the play triggers is real, and every check rests on what the platform returned ({output}, {cite:...}), never on text the play wrote itself, except the one plain answer.

corpus.title: Refund window
corpus.text: Refund requests must be submitted within 30 days of the delivery date. Once approved, the amount is returned to the original payment method and typically appears within five business days.

corpus.title: Refund conditions
corpus.text: Items must be unused and in their original packaging to qualify for a refund. Products showing wear, missing accessories, or damage caused after delivery are not eligible.

corpus.title: Exchanges
corpus.text: Exchanges are accepted for 60 days and may be made for any item of equal or lesser value. Exchanges do not require the original packaging, unlike refunds.

corpus.title: Store credit
corpus.text: Store credit never expires and can be combined with other payment methods at checkout. It cannot be converted back into cash.

corpus.title: Dispatch
corpus.text: Orders placed before noon are dispatched the same business day. Standard dispatch otherwise takes up to two business days.

corpus.title: Delivery
corpus.text: Domestic parcels usually arrive three to five business days after dispatch. Tracking numbers are emailed as soon as the carrier scans the parcel.

corpus.title: International orders
corpus.text: International orders may be held by customs, which can add one to three weeks. Any duties or import taxes are the recipient's responsibility.

corpus.title: Warranty length
corpus.text: All hardware carries a two year limited warranty beginning on the date of purchase. Batteries and other consumable parts are covered for the first six months only.

corpus.title: Warranty exclusions
corpus.text: Accidental damage, liquid ingress, and damage from unauthorised repairs are not covered by the limited warranty. Extended protection plans cover accidental damage separately.

corpus.title: Account closure
corpus.text: You can close your account from the privacy settings page. Closure is permanent after a 14 day grace period, during which signing in restores the account.

corpus.title: Password reset
corpus.text: Use the 'forgot password' link on the sign-in page to receive a reset email. Reset links expire after one hour for security reasons.

corpus.title: Support hours
corpus.text: Live chat is staffed Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm. Emails sent outside those hours are answered on the next working day.
